work.description: The seventh volume of the second series of the Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers translation anthology, containing Edwin Hamilton Gifford's translation of the Catechetical Lectures of Cyril of Jerusalem and the orations and letters of Gregory Nazianzen translated by Charles Gordon Browne and James Edward Swallow. Its container identity remains distinct from the works and translated editions printed within it.
